title: RTEC ADA complaint process
trigger: Allegation of disability discrimination involving RTEC service, vehicles or facilities.

source_timelines.filing: within 5 calendar days of alleged incident
source_timelines.initial_contact: ADA Coordinator contacts complainant within 10 business days
source_timelines.investigation_start: within 15 business days if allegation is found to be an ADA-regulation matter
source_timelines.investigation_completion: within 60 calendar days unless additional time is communicated
source_timelines.appeal: within 5 business days of receiving RTEC's response

steps: Accept complaint by form or telephone; provide assistance if complainant cannot write the complaint.
Coordinator contacts complainant and obtains needed information.
Determine whether the allegation falls within ADA complaint scope.
Investigate and document compliance with ADA requirements.
Allow appeal within the source-stated window.
Close when resolved or when required information is not provided within the source's timeframe.
accessibility: Source provides telephone, TTY/Kentucky Relay pathways and bilingual notice language.
controls: Do not operationalize the 5-calendar-day filing window without confirming this source is still current.
Complaint details and disability/medical information remain restricted.
unresolved_questions: What is the effective/revision date of this ADA complaint procedure?
Is the 5-day filing deadline still current?
Who is the current ADA Coordinator and what system is used for complaint tracking?
